g.text: Series resonance minimizes impedance and maximizes current

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Ideal series RLC with frequency-independent R and source RMS voltage. At resonance X_L+X_C=0, |Z|=R and I_max=1 A. Half-power frequencies satisfy |Z|=√2R
and I=I_max/√2; their difference is bandwidth. Q=f₀/Δf.
